413:t_1:3.en: ～$$ガルガンティア船団$$　Fleet Commander's Room～

413:t_1:6.en:
$$リジット$$
「The great shipowner $$フランジ$$'s group has left, and the Fleet Commander has died... At this rate, $$ガルガンティア$$ will...」

413:t_1:7.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Pull yourself together, $$リジット$$. You're the Fleet Commander now.」

413:t_1:8.en:
$$リジット$$
「$$クラウン$$ should have become Fleet Commander... Nobody will trust someone as young as me...」

413:t_1:9.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「$$クラウン$$'s getting on in years, too. Either way, we need to train someone to take over.」

413:t_1:11.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...Anyway, you have a visitor. Someone from $c came to pay their respects to the Fleet Commander.」

413:t_1:13.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Please accept my condolences for your loss.」

413:t_1:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The late Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$ did a great deal for us. $c is on operations, so I've come to pay our respects on their behalf.」

413:t_1:16.en:
$$リジット$$
「Thank you for coming all this way. I'm sure $$フェアロック$$ would be pleased.」

413:t_1:17.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...I've come here today for another reason besides paying my respects.」

413:t_1:19.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Someone is targeting the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

413:t_1:20.en:
$$リジット$$
「It can't be...! I thought $$サイデリアル$$ had been defeated...!」

413:t_1:21.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They're still observing for now, but a group distinct from $$サイデリアル$$ and the pirates is approaching $$ガルガンティア$$.」

413:t_1:22.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Of course, we have no intention of overlooking such lawlessness. But I would like you to steel yourself as well, Fleet Commander $$リジット$$.」

413:t_1:23.en:
$$リジット$$
「You say I must steel myself... but I've only just become Fleet Commander, and we've barely finished $$フェアロック$$'s funeral...」

413:t_1:25.en:
$$リジット$$
「...There's... nothing I can do right now...」

413:t_1:26.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Fleet Commander $$リジット$$... How old do you think I am?」

413:t_1:28.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm 17. And I was even younger when I became captain of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」

413:t_1:29.en:
$$テッサ$$
「As you know, that makes me unusual even among $c's captains.」

413:t_1:30.en:
$$リジット$$
「That's... because you have special talents...」

413:t_1:31.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I won't deny that. ...But I can't do anything alone.」

413:t_1:32.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I... may not look it, but I'm terribly unathletic. I can't even handle a gun properly, and I trip on perfectly flat, empty ground.」

413:t_1:34.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But I have reliable subordinates and friends.」

413:t_1:36.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「That's what we're saying, $$リジット$$.」

413:t_1:37.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...I know you're trying hard. You're doing enough.」

413:t_1:38.en:
$$リジット$$
「If I were doing enough, we wouldn't have any problems...」

413:t_1:39.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Doing enough and being perfect are different. ...I went through a time like this, too.」

413:t_1:41.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「It was when my salvage boss put me in charge... I got worked up and took everything on alone. I ended up making a huge mistake...」

413:t_1:42.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Hehe... So even the fearsome salvage master $$ベローズ$$ went through a time like that.」

413:t_1:43.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Have you made mistakes too, Captain Butterfingers?」

413:t_1:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Well... I've made mistakes. I can't tell you about them here, though.」

413:t_1:46.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「$$ピニオン$$ laughed at me no end back then... 'You're not looking around you. That's the same as not trusting your crew,' he said.」

413:t_1:48.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You can't just handle everything alone. So...」

413:t_1:49.en:
$$リジット$$
「But Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$ did...」

413:t_1:50.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Did he? Whenever I met the former Fleet Commander, you were always by his side.」

413:t_1:51.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Even that old man relied on you.」

413:t_1:52.en:
$$リジット$$
「Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$ did...」

413:t_1:53.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「What you need to do is think about who you should ask to do what so things go well, isn't it?」

413:t_1:54.en:
$$リジット$$
「I should rely on others...」

413:t_1:55.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Exactly. If you become the fleet's brain, others will be its limbs and heart.」

413:t_1:56.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You'll put the things I salvage to good use... That's the kind of person I want to entrust my ship to.」

413:t_1:62.en:
$$フランジ$$
「...So, in short, we've qualified to become members of this fleet.」

413:t_1:63.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「It seems so. Apparently, they think I'm useful because I fixed up the treasure so we could use it.」

413:t_1:64.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「They say I've got talent. They even told me I could eventually create new weapons.」

413:t_1:65.en:
$$フランジ$$
「Don't be fooled, $$ピニオン$$. This fleet just wants to absorb us.」

413:t_1:67.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「That's right. And that is precisely what will bring you happiness.」

413:t_1:69.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「May those who follow providence be blessed. May those who defy providence feel God's hammer.」

413:t_1:70.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, hey...! We're not trying to pick a fight with you!」

413:t_1:72.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「They are going to God.」

413:t_1:73.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What the hell are you talking about?! If you tie their hands and feet and throw them in the sea, they'll die!」

413:t_1:74.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「They die for the living, to offer the utmost gratitude... They shall receive eternal honor for the salvation of humanity.」

413:t_1:76.en:
$$フランジ$$
「This is... how this fleet does things...」

413:t_1:77.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「May those who follow providence be blessed. May those who defy providence feel God's hammer. ...Kneel.」

413:t_1:79.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「I grant you a blessing, new servants of $$クーゲル$$.」

413:t_1:80.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「In the name of providence, may you devote your bodies and strength to the great cause.」

413:t_1:82.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「$$ピニオン$$ of the $$霧の海$$...」

413:t_1:84.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「The giant of thunder will soon take flight to spread God's will... You will assist it.」
